# Shield KYA features

> Generated from sdks/kya/features.json by `pnpm sync:features`. Do not edit by hand. Lists the live open source
> CLI features. Hosted features: https://shield-agent.com/docs/kya/hosted-commands. Full table with docs links:
> https://docs.shield-agent.com/features.html

## Features

- Print version: Prints the installed kya version and exits. Command or flag: `kya version`, `--version`, `-v`, `-V`.
- One-line start: Wires the local MCP gate into your coding host and opens the live report in the background. Command or flag: `kya start`, `--no-open`, `--force`, `--no-gate`.
- Stop report server: Stops the background report server that kya start began. Command or flag: `kya stop`, `--all`.
- Scaffold config: Creates the .kya config folder with sample tools and an env example. Command or flag: `kya init`, `--force`.
- Wire a coding host: Writes the KYA MCP server into the config of one coding host (12 hosts). Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--project`, `--force`.
- Wire PreToolUse hook: Writes the PreToolUse hook for claude, grok or kimi. With --project, the claude hook goes into the project's .claude/settings.json. Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--hooks`.
- Point host at gateway: Points a coding host at the local kya gateway. Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--gate`.
- Self-update and version banner: Updates kya to the latest npm version. kya start warns when a newer release exists. Command or flag: `kya update`, `--no-update-check`, `KYA_UPDATE_CHECK`.
- Node 22 check and handoff: Checks the Node version and hands off to a supported Node 22 or newer. Command or flag: none.
- Homebrew install: Installs kya with Homebrew from The-Pixel-Boys tap. Command or flag: `brew install The-Pixel-Boys/tap/shield-kya`.
- Scoop install: Installs kya on Windows with Scoop. Command or flag: `scoop install shield-kya`.
- Team rollout: commit plugin pin: Adds a tag-pinned plugin marketplace and an enabled plugin to the project settings for everyone who opens the repo. Command or flag: `kya team init`, `--dry-run`.
- Managed-settings JSON for admins: Prints the managed-settings JSON an administrator deploys. Command or flag: `kya team managed-settings`.
- Repository policy file: Optional .kya/policy.json committed with the repo. Adds deny and requireApprove tool ids for the local gate; it cannot relax a verdict, and an invalid file is ignored with a note. Command or flag: `.kya/policy.json`.
- Opt-in usage stats: Anonymous usage stats, off by default. Status, on, off, show and reset. Command or flag: `kya telemetry`, `--purge`.
- Global activity record: Keeps a global activity log in the KYA home folder. Reports read the last 1 MB of it. Command or flag: `KYA_HOME`.
- Activity report: Writes the activity report as HTML, JSON or Markdown for the last few days or one session. Command or flag: `kya receipt`, `--open`, `--days`, `--session`, `--q`, `--json`, `--out`.
- Redacted share link: Publishes a redacted summary of the report and prints a public link. Command or flag: `kya receipt`, `--share`, `--share-url`, `--share-retries`, `KYA_SHARE_URL`.
- Natural-language search in report: Search box in the activity report. Command or flag: none.
- Map of agent actions: Graph and heat views of what KYA recorded for agent actions on this machine. Local only. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya map`, `--days`, `--json`, `--html`, `--session`.
- Agent-flow export: Writes the local trail as an agent-flow JSONL event log. Classes only, no args. Local only. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya export`, `--format`, `--days`, `--session`, `--out`, `--force`.
- Redacted change previews: Shows clipped, redacted change previews on the report. Set KYA_DIFF_PREVIEW=0 to turn them off. Command or flag: `KYA_DIFF_PREVIEW`.
- Terminal desk: Terminal view with free panes. Actions work on a TTY; --once prints one frame for CI. Command or flag: `kya dash`, `--once`, `--pane`.
- IoC check: Scans this machine for known supply-chain indicators. Read-only and offline. Runs once a day in the background from kya hook and shows in kya doctor, kya dash and kya receipt. Command or flag: `kya doctor`, `kya doctor --iocs`, `--iocs`, `--json`, `KYA_IOC=0`, `ioc.enabled=false`.
- Developer posture report (opt-in): Off by default. kya posture on prints the exact report and asks; a send needs the local toggle, a hosted login and the workspace policy. Minimised fields only; the client refuses any report with an environment name or value, a path, a user or host name, or an IP address. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya posture`, `status`, `on`, `off`, `send`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, `label`, `--yes`.
- Cost showback: Observe-only cost showback inside the activity report. Command or flag: none.
- Never-list block: Blocks never-list tools in the PreToolUse hook. kya hook exits 2 on DENY. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Guard pack: Second layer of local denies in the PreToolUse hook, local and hosted (--plane-config): destructive shell commands, credential reads, secret-shaped writes and secret exfiltration. Config and guardAllow come from the user-level ~/.kya/config.json only. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Advisory hook record: Records ALLOW and REQUIRE_APPROVE decisions in the hook. The call proceeds. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Strict hook mode: Strict mode denies advisory decisions in the hook. Command or flag: `kya hook`, `--strict`.
- Local MCP gate server: Serves the local MCP gate over HTTP, or over stdio for hosts. Command or flag: `kya serve-mcp`, `--stdio`, `--port`.
- Local MCP gateway: Governs and audits tool calls to any MCP server through a local gateway. Command or flag: `kya gate`, `kya gate init`, `kya gate setup`, `kya gate run`, `kya gate stop`, `kya gate status`, `kya gate doctor`.
- Destructive names and ADMIN tier denied: Gateway policy denies destructive tool names and the ADMIN tier. Command or flag: none.
- Auto-import of host MCP servers: kya start imports MCP servers found in host configs into the gateway. Turn off with --no-gate or KYA_GATE=off. Command or flag: `kya start`, `--no-gate`, `KYA_GATE`.
- Evaluate and record a command: Evaluates a command and records it in the trail. With --tool-id it never runs anything. With `-- <cmd>` it runs the command only when the verdict allows. Command or flag: `kya wrap`, `--offline`, `--hold`, `--json`, `--work-item`, `--tool-id`, `--irreversible`.
- Policy evaluate, exit codes: Evaluates a tool call against policy and exits with a code per verdict. Command or flag: `kya eval-tool`, `--offline`, `--tool-id`, `--irreversible`, `--args`, `--session-risk`, `--risk`, `--approval-status`, `--sandbox-id`.
- Read-only ORR board: Builds a read-only ORR board from producers and writes a report. It is not a second policy point. Command or flag: `kya orr run`, `--path`, `--producer`, `--out`, `--skip-optional-producers`, `--agentshield-json`, `--commit-sha`, `--name`, `--rubric`, `--disable-category`, `--usage`, `--scorecard`, `--quiet`, `--json-stdout`, `--fail-on`, `--format`.
- Trust baseline gap report: Lists gaps in the Agent Trust Baseline from local evidence. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--window`, `--fail-on`, `--open`, `--json-stdout`, `--catalog`, `--out`, `--format`, `--quiet`.
- Local attestation: Records a local attestation for one requirement ID. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--attest`, `--text`.
- Self-signed evidence bundle: Writes a self-signed evidence bundle. It shows integrity and key continuity, not identity. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--sign`.
- EU AI Act mapping: Maps certify evidence to EU AI Act articles. Command or flag: none.
- Import foreign traces: Imports traces from other tools into the local trail so the report and certify can read them. Command or flag: `kya import`, `--from`, `--file`.
- Detections and fix briefs: Finds detections in the trail, groups them into incidents and writes fix briefs for coding agents. Command or flag: `kya investigate`, `--json`.
- Endpoint discovery: Scans this endpoint for AI agents, IDEs, runtimes and MCP servers. Command or flag: `kya discover`, `--json`, `--diff`, `--push`, `--file`.
- Opt-in Firecracker wrap: Opt-in sandbox that runs a command inside a Firecracker VM. Not an MCP tool. Command or flag: `kya sandbox`, `--sandbox`, `--sandbox-id`, `--cmd`, `--path`, `--offline`, `KYA_SANDBOX`.
- Alerts: Sends decision alerts and incident alerts to webhooks set in the config file, and shows a desktop notification for each new incident alert. Incident alerts are off by default. `kya start` offers them once; an optional local triage model is part of the offer. Command or flag: `kya alerts`, `kya alerts status`, `kya alerts test`, `kya alerts on`, `kya alerts off`, `--json`, `KYA_ALERTS=on`, `alerts.desktop`, `KYA_ALERTS_DESKTOP=off`.
- Local triage model for security alerts: Optional offline model (ModernBERT-base, int8 ONNX, about 150 MB) that adds category, urgency, next step and a benign score to each incident alert. Offered once by `kya start` (Turn on security alerts? [Y/n]). One sha256-pinned download. Advisory: it never removes an alert and never changes the severity. Command or flag: `KYA_ALERTS=on`, `KYA_ALERTS=off`, `KYA_TRIAGE_MODEL_PATH`.
- OTLP export: Exports metrics to an OpenTelemetry collector through the gateway OTLP receiver. Command or flag: `otlpPort`.
- OTLP map attributes: Adds the target class and the hashed device id to decision spans. Opt-in in the user-level config only. Default off. Command or flag: `otlpExport.mapAttrs`.
- In-process SDK shims: Adapters for in-process agent SDKs: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents and Vercel AI. Command or flag: none.
- Python framework shim: Python package shield-kya that gives agent frameworks the KYA checks. Command or flag: `pip install shield-kya`.
- Claude Code plugin: Claude Code plugin for kya, installed from the shield-kya marketplace. Command or flag: `/plugin install kya@shield-kya`.
- Codex plugin: Codex plugin for kya. Command or flag: `codex plugin add kya@shield-kya`.
- Copilot CLI plugin: Copilot CLI plugin for kya. Command or flag: `copilot plugin install kya@shield-kya`.
- Gemini CLI extension: Gemini CLI extension for kya. Command or flag: `gemini extensions install`.
- Cursor plugin: Cursor plugin manifest for kya. Command or flag: none.
- VS Code extension: VS Code extension for kya, published on the Visual Studio Marketplace. Command or flag: none.
- GitHub Action kya-certify: GitHub Action that runs kya certify in a workflow. Command or flag: `uses: The-Pixel-Boys/kya-action`.
- Org Hold: Holds a call for an org approval path instead of observing it. Command or flag: `KYA_HOLD`, `--hold`.
- Plane connection and keys: Connects the CLI to the hosted plane with an API key, a base URL, a host and an agent ID. Command or flag: `KYA_API_KEY`, `KYA_BASE_URL`, `KYA_HOST`, `--base-url`, `--api-key`, `--host`, `--agent-id`.
- Hosted login (device code): Links this machine to the hosted console with a device code. Saves a full-workspace key with mode 0600 in ~/.kya/hosted-credentials.json. Command or flag: `kya login`, `--base-url`.
- Sign out on this machine: Deletes the saved hosted key file on this machine. The key stays active on the server until revoked. Command or flag: `kya logout`.
- Hosted calls to action: One line, at most once a day, after kya certify (gaps) and kya receipt. Silent in CI, non-TTY, KYA_QUIET, KYA_CTA=0 and config opt-out. Command or flag: `KYA_QUIET`, `KYA_CTA`.
